hero.label: Project1000
hero.title: Namibia's Digital Employment Initiative
hero.subtitle: Project1000 is an MICT national initiative implemented by Impact Tank to create 1,000 digital jobs for Namibian youth.

role.title: Label Ladder's Role
role.description: As a contributing employer, Label Ladder provides Namibians with the tools and knowledge to work in technology, AI, and data industries.
points: Contributing employer in the Project1000 initiative
Providing hands-on training in tech, AI, and data
Creating sustainable digital employment for Namibian youth
Bridging the gap between global technology and local talent

academy.title: Label Ladder Academy
academy.description: We guarantee employees a pathway to growth and employability in a globally competitive industry.
academy.subtitle: Our 5-stage academy curriculum prepares Namibian talent for the global digital economy:

stages.title: Digital Foundations
stages.description: Core computer skills, internet literacy, and workplace readiness

stages.title: Data & AI Basics
stages.description: Introduction to data annotation, machine learning concepts, and AI tools

stages.title: Specialist Training
stages.description: Domain-specific annotation skills: text, image, video, audio

stages.title: Quality & Process
stages.description: Quality assurance, workflow management, and professional standards

stages.title: Career Development
stages.description: Portfolio building, client communication, and global industry readiness

cta.title: Join the Movement
cta.description: Whether you are an institution looking for digital services or a partner wanting to support Namibia's digital future — let's connect.
